title: 10.1.0 | Chorus of Sin
body:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/9c4806e879b72c1e3395e821b431717cc14ce1ed.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h2][b]New Killer: The Judgment[/b][/h2][p][b]POWER: WILL OF THE GODS[/b][/p][p][b]DIVINE LIGHT[/b][/p][list][*][p]Press and hold the Power Button to summon Divine Light for up to [b]3s.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Divine Light moves away from The Judgment and is controlled with camera controls (left/right only).[/p][/*][*][p]While in this state, Divine Light does not damage Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]If Divine Light passes through obstacles, it slows down[b].[/b][/p][/*][*][p]While controlling Divine Light, press the Attack Button to Cast it forward.[/p][/*][*][p]When Cast, it enters a brief delay before it fully activates, damaging and applying Heresy to any Survivors hit. [i](Survivors inflicted with Heresy are known as Heretics)
Dev note: Divine Light enters its lethal state when it becomes larger.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]When cast Divine Light is lethal and if misses a Survivor by [b]0.5m[/b], reveal them with Killer Instinct for [b]2s[/b][/p][/*][*][p]The longer Divine Light is controlled:
[/p][list][*][p]The shorter the Cast delay[/p][/*][*][p]The longer the Cast duration[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Divine Light has a [b]6 [/b]second cooldown.
[i]Dev note: Divine Light's delay phase duration starts at 0.9s, after controlling Divine Light for 1s, the delay reaches its minimum of 0.3s[/i]
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]ZEALOUS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Press the Secondary Ability Button to Exile a Heretic in the Dying State, gaining Zealous. ([i]If they have 2 Hook States, they are killed instead.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Exiling a Survivor gives them a Hook State.[/p][/*][*][p]When Exiling a Heretic:[/p][list][*][p]The [b]2[/b] closest Shrines of Judgment become Active[/p][/*][*][p]Zealous lasts for [b]60 seconds.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Gain Killer Instinct on all Heretics for [b]3s. [/b][i](only applies to Survivors with full Heresy)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]While Zealous:[/p][list][*][p]Increase Divine Light's size by[b] 10%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Decrease Divine Light's cooldown by [b]20%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Maintain control of Divine Light for up to [b]0.3s
[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]EXILE[/b][/p][list][*][p]Exile acts like a Hook, but does not trigger Hook-related perks.[/p][/*][*][p]Upon entering Exile, Survivors receive a Searcher's Pendant [i](Limited Item).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Exile is filled with dangerous Seeds of Punishment that reduce a Survivor's Sacrifice timer by [b]3s [/b]when hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Exile is also filled with helpful Exiled Souls. Hold the Use Item button to point the Searcher's Pendant at Exiled Souls to collect them.[/p][/*][*][p]For each Exiled Soul collected (up to 10), Survivors gain an additional [b]0.5s[/b] to default Unhook Protections (10% Haste, Endurance, and Elusive).[/p][/*][*][p]Exiled Souls no longer grant additional protections once all Generators are completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors who aren't in Exile can Pray at an active Shrine of Judgment [i](highlighted in red) [/i]to rescue Exiled Survivors.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]HERESY[/b][/p][list][*][p]Heresy is gained when hit by Divine Light or by taunting The Judgment (crouching repeatedly, gesturing or lingering in the Exit Area... [i]just leave[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Heretics suffer from special Skill Checks while repairing Generators. Good Skill Check results cause the Generator to lose some progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Heretics can Repent at a Shrine of Judgment to begin depleting their Heresy over time.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]THE JUDGMENT - CUSTOM SETTINGS[/b][/p][list][*][p]The following settings can be found in the General settings tab under Beta, then The Judgment section[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Divine Light - Control Settings[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sensitivity settings exclusive to The Judgment[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Divine Light - Near Miss Killer Instinct feedback[/b][/p][list][*][p]Killer Instinct feedback setting exclusive to The Judgment[/p][/*][*][p]This setting is ON by default
[i]Dev note: We understand that Killer Instinct can get overwhelming for some players. We've added this setting to allow you to disable this specific feedback from The Judgment while playing.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]New Killer Perks[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Celestial Witness[/b][/p][list][*][p]Every [b]30s[/b], if the Obsession is at least [b]40m[/b] away from you, you see their Aura for[b] 2/2.5/3s[/b]. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hex: Under Your Thumb[/b][/p][list][*][p]The first time a Survivor gains a hook state, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever a running Survivor gains Haste within [b]32m[/b] of you, you are alerted.
Running survivors cannot gain more than [b]25/20/15%[/b] Haste at a time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Lay Waste[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you damage a Generator, for each Charge it has, it regresses [b]2%[/b] faster. [b]Cooldown: 55/50/45s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]New Survivor: Aurora[/b][/h2][p][b]New Survivor Perks[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fruits of your Labor[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn 1 Token.
Whenever you finish repairing a Generator, for each Token:[/p][list][*][p]You gain [b]5%[/b] Haste for [b]2s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]You gain [b]10/15/20%[/b] healing progress.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Salvation's Cry[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever the Killer starts chasing you:[/p][list][*][p]You see the Auras of other Survivors for [b]1/2/3s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors not being chased see your Aura for [b]5s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors not being chased see the Killer's Aura for [b]5s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Boon: Steadfast[/b][/p][list][*][p]While next to a Totem, use "E" to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.
Generators within the Boon's range:[/p][list][*][p]Regress [b]50%[/b] slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors repair them [b]8/9/10%[/b] faster.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Survivors within the Boon's range see the Auras of affected Generators.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Base game updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Unhook Protections:
[/b]Anytime a Survivor is unhooked, they gain Endurance and 10% Haste for [b]10 seconds.[/b] [i](was 15 seconds)
[/i]Anytime a Survivor is unhooked, they gain Elusive for [b]10 seconds[/b]. [i](NEW - This does not apply once all generators are powered)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Killer perk updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]A Nurse's Calling:
[/b]Within [b]28/30/32m[/b] of Survivors who are healing or being healed, you see their Auras. [i](Reveals all Survivors in a healing interaction, regardless of their health state)
Dev note: There has been some confusion about the expected behaviour with A Nurse's Calling, we felt it was a good opportunity to make it more consistent and clearer.[/i][b]
[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Call of Brine:
[/b]Whenever you damage a Generator, it regresses [b]30/40/50%[/b] faster for [b]90s[/b]. [i](was 70 seconds)[/i]
For that time, whenever a Survivor hits a good basic Skill Check while repairing that Generator, you are alerted.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coulrophobia:
[/b]Survivors within your Terror Radius:
Heal [b]20/25/30%[/b] slower. [i](was 30/40/50%)[/i]
While healing, basic Skill Checks spin [b]50%[/b] faster.
[i]Dev note: Because we're buffing A Nurse's Calling back to its pre-9.2.0 state while keeping the range buff, we felt it was safer to adjust Coulrophobia at the same time to decrease its synergy with certain builds.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hex: Thrill of the Hunt:
[/b]When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.
For each Dull and Hex Totem remaining, you have [b]1 [/b]Token.
For each Token, Survivors bless and cleanse Totems [b]8/9/10% slower[/b]. [i](was 8/10/12%)
Dev note: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt has excelled at defending totem builds in the recent patches. We're slightly lowering its efficiency while reviewing the perk in the long term.
[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Keep Them Waiting:
[/b]Whenever you damage a Survivor who is not the Obsession with a basic-attack, you earn [b]1 [/b]Token, up to [b]6/7/8[/b].
For each Token, your basic-attack cooldown are [b]5%[/b] shorter. ([i]was 4%)[/i]
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, lose [b]2 [/b]Tokens.
While the Obsession is dead, you cannot earn Tokens.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nowhere to Hide:
[/b]Whenever you damage a Generator, for [b]3/4/5s[/b], you see the Auras of Survivors within [b]24m[/b] of the Generator. [i](was revealing auras around the Killer position)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Survivor perk updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Sprint Burst:
[/b]Whenever you start running:[/p][list][*][p]You gain [b]50% [/b]Haste for [b]2s[/b]. [i](was 3 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You gain Exhausted for [b]60/50/40s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Apocalyptic Ingenuity:
[/b]After you rummage or unlock [b]1 [/b]Chest, while next to a Broken Pallet, use Active Ability Button[b] [/b]for [b]3s[/b] to create a Fragile Pallet. [i](was 2 chests, and 4 seconds)[/i]
Within [b]24/28/32m[/b], you see the Auras of Broken Pallets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deliverance:
[/b]Once per trial, when you safely unhook another Survivor, you can unhook yourself. When you unhook yourself this way, you gain Broken for [b]160/140/120s[/b]. [i](was 100/80/60 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Vigil
[/b]All Survivors within [b]16m[/b] of you:
  Lose Blindness [b]30/35/40%[/b] faster. [i](was 44/55/66%)
[/i]  Lose Broken [b]30/35/40%[/b] faster. [i](was 44/55/66%)
[/i]  Lose Exhausted [b]30/35/40%[/b] faster. [i](was 44/55/66%)
[/i]  Lose Exposed [b]30/35/40%[/b] faster. [i](was 44/55/66%)
[/i]  Lose Hemorrhage [b]30/35/40%[/b] faster. [i](was 44/55/66%)
[/i]  Lose Hindered [b]30/35/40%[/b] faster. [i](was 44/55/66%)
[/i]  Lose Mangled [b]30/35/40%[/b] faster. [i](was 44/55/66%)
[/i]  Lose Oblivious [b]30/35/40%[/b] faster. [i](was 44/55/66%)
[/i]After they leave your range, this ends after [b]15s[/b].
[i]Dev note: We heard the feedback that Vigil affects too many status effects. We will review the list of effects in an upcoming bugfix patch.[/i]
[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Adrenaline:
[/b]When all Generators are completed, if you are downed or injured, heal instantly. Then, ignoring Exhausted:[/p][list][*][p]You gain [b]50% [/b]Haste for [b]4s[/b]. [i](was 3 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You gain Exhausted for [b]60/50/40s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Clean Break:
[/b]Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while being healed by another Survivor, use the Active Ability Button to gain Broken.
After [b]75/60/45s[/b], if you are not downed, you are instantly healed. [i](was 80/70/60 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Moment of Glory:
[/b]After you rummage or unlock [b]1 [/b]Chest, while not Broken, when you become injured, gain Broken.
If you do not take damage, after [b]80/70/60s[/b], you are instantly healed. [i](was previously 2 chests)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Repressed Alliance:
[/b]After repairing Generators for [b]55/50/45s[/b], while repairing a Generator alone, use[b] [/b]the Active Ability button to block that generator for [b]15s[/b]. [i](was 30 seconds)[/i]
[i]Dev note: We heard the feedback about the requirement to activate the perk being a little too high. We will reassess this for an upcoming patch.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Technician:
[/b]While repairing a Generator:[/p][list][*][p]The range of Generator repair noises is [b]16m[/b] shorter. [i](was 8 meters shorter)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, the Generator does not explode, but loses [b]4/3/2%[/b] more progress.[b] [/b][i](was 5/4/3%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][list][*][p]New Gameplay Showcase Section[/p][list][*][p]Can be entered through Survivors and Killers lobbies[/p][/*][*][p]Killer Power's icon is also a point of entry for the section[/p][/*][*][p]Section includes detailed description of all Killers' Powers, separated by killer and Key Aspect[/p][/*][*][p]Each Key Aspect is accompanied by an example video[/p][/*][*][p]Section includes the list of Killers for players to be able to preview their power[/p][/*][*][p]Only accessible outside matches[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Power Tooltip updated[/p][list][*][p]Old Power Tooltip used to describe a Killer Power entirely is updated[/p][/*][*][p]Content has been removed, replaced by the same Action-based description used on the F1 section of Match Details[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updated Matchmaking Button[/p][list][*][p]Updated visuals, and reduced its intensity, following PTB's feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Surfaces both estimated waiting time and current time on queue[/p][/*][*][p]Bonuses and other complementary information is displayed through new tooltip[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hook Timer Division[/p][list][*][p]The hook timer has been split into two bars, to better clarify the second hook state and death triggers.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated for scenarios when a Survivor is on a hook, in a Cage of Corruption (Game Mode: 2V8) or Cage of Torment (The Executioner), and in Exile (The Judgment).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]MMR Update[/p][list][*][p]The way MMR is calculated has now changed, it will no longer count only Kills and Escapes. Similar to Emblems it will now consider more actions within a trial.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where subtitles might have disappeared before voice over finished.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Aurora's hooked voice lines would not play.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Aurora's failed skill check voice lines would not play.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Characters[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Slasher's Mini Mori wall-impale on Survivor had the Spike misaligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where William Birkin's skins were missing a few idle animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Clown's knife cleaning animation after a successful basic attack was not properly aligned with his hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Huntress's Axe was misaligned when she was about to throw her hatchet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Artist's weapon briefly appears in the lobby when wearing the 'Miss Fuchi' outfit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Yui Kimura's upper left chest caved inward when wearing the 'Mikasa's Dark Uniform' outfit during the idle lobby animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Ash J. Williams's ankles caved inward when wearing the 'Water Trash' outfit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Legion's 'Hunk' legendary outfit's hand would clip into the pouch in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Unknown's Greenville Pep and Greenville Cheer cosmetics' teeth appeared to be stuck together, resulting in them stretching during the killer's Mori.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the VFX for the Pride's flashlight was missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Blight's Lethal Rush Attack was unable to hit Survivors when the Survivor was inside the Killer's hitbox.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Blight's side movements were disabled after the second Rush.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Executioner's Punishment of the Damned failed to travel uphill.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Skull Merchant's prompt to Deploy a Drone appeared within the Anti-Camp radius when on a different height.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Killers were unaffected by the movement penalty when a Survivor was wiggling.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors were able to escape while The Twins' Victor had them bound.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where idle Generators regressed when affected by Aurora Stardotter's Boon: Steadfast.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where addon status effects from The Pig's add-ons were not applied to Survivors when the Video Tape add-on was also used.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the camera jittered a lot while The Wraith was invisible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Demogorgon could become invisible while entering a portal with lag.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Nurse could remain stuck on top of a fence after a Blink on Autohaven Wreckers.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bots Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issues causing Survivor bots to not dodge special attacks toward the intended direction.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivor Bots now have a chance to misdodge Special attacks based on how fast they reacted to the attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues causing Survivor bots to not heal other Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivor Bots are now more brave against Killers that are not moving away from a location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing Survivor Bots to give up their goal too easily when entering the Terror Radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivor Bots no longer try to remove an inactive Reverse Bear Trap after all generators have been completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing Survivor Bots to prevent heals while in the Dying state.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Yamaoka's Family Residence where the Nurse could blink on top railings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Nostromos where navigation is hindered by collisions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Eyrie of Crows where the Nurse can blink inside of the stairs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Treatment Theater where the Nightmare gets stuck in the main room[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Gideon Meat Plant where the Nurse could blink out of the environment[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Toba Landing where the Nurse can blink under the main structure[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Freddy Fazzbear's Pizza the Nurse could not blink through the wall[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Ironworks of Misery where the Nurse can blink through the stairs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Autohaven Wreckers where the Nurse get stuck under the hill of the realm[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Exile tile where the players would get stuck on rocks on the ground[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Toba Landing where a rock clips through the inside of the locker[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Balckwater Swamp Realm where the Nurse can get stuck under floor board[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Grim Pantry where the Nurse can get stuck inside a rock[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Trickster's Delusion where lockers are doubled in the alley near the night club[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Mother's Dwelling where the dark lord gets stuck against a meat hook in the smoke house when in bat form[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Skull Merchant was unable to deploy a Drone on the stairs and on the 2nd floor of the Main Building on Dvarka Deepwood[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue on the Autohaven Wreckers - Blood Lodge's map where the Nurse can Blink on top of the fence and be stuck between the fence and chimney.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Perks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Plot Twist deactivated the Corrupt Intervention Perk early.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Plot Twist could trigger Eruption[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Hex: Under Your Thumb's external icon was displayed to Survivors without the Haste Status Effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Boon: Steadfast's repair speed effect did not apply upon blessing the Totem while a Survivor was repairing a Generator.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Boon: Steadfast's effect stacked when a Generator was in range of two Boon Totems.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]The DBD game logo has been updated to the latest version across the game[/p][/*][*][p]The Players Tab in Match Details now shows the Killer's Portrait instead of their Power Icon[/p][list][*][p]It is a known issue that a handful of Legendary cosmetics to not have a Killer Portrait icon. This will be fixed in an upcoming release.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would freeze for a bit when hovering over the quest button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the faces on The Judgment's legs were missing from the Customization icons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an incorrect image was displayed on the interrupt and grab 1 survivor(s) quest[/p][/*][*][p]Polished visual issues on the Summertime Smash Banner[/p][/*][*][p]Polished the Clawing Death Banner to ensure Sable was not cut off by the screen edge[/p][/*][*][p]Polished Mikaela's dress on the Sunshine, or Whatever Banner[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the matchmaking button would display incorrect player counts and ready states[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the character name shown in a player's lobby tag would not update after switching to a legendary customization[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the unblock option was missing from the social dropdown in the lobby on some platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the name in a player's lobby tag would not change color when hovered[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the ban countdown timer in the matchmaking button displayed an incorrect time after receiving DPP[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the queue timer in the matchmaking button would reset after navigating between screens[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where game would crash while leaving or joining a match[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Female Survivors had distorted facial animations[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Changes from PTB
[/b][/h2][p][b]New Killer: The Judgment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Divine Light:[/p][list][*][p]Added visuals for when Divine Light has reached its maximum potential (i.e. when the delay duration reaches its shortest and the Cast duration its highest)[/p][/*][*][p]Added Killer Instinct when Divine Light puts a Survivor in the Dying State
[/p][/*][*][p]Added Killer Instinct when Divine Light misses a Survivor by [b]0.5m[/b]
[i]Dev Note: This is ON by default, but it can be disabled in the General Settings, under the Beta tab, in The Judgment's Custom Settings section. When equipping Heretic's Mark, the setting is automatically set to ON.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Increase distance at which Cast Divine Light's Aura is revealed to Survivors to 48 m (was 32 m)
[i]Dev note: Improving accessibility is something we take very seriously. We've increased this range due to Divine Light's travel speed (and the fact that it goes through walls). In the event that more is needed, we will add a visual indicator in a future hotfix. These both have levers we can adjust to meet our goal while minimizing the impact it has on The Judgment.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]While Zealous, the curve window for Divine Light is set to [b]0.3s [/b][i](was scaling based on controlled state duration)
Dev note: This should help Killer players get more consistent results with Divine Light curves while Zealous. This value was chosen as a starting point to better assess what data we get from a consistent curve window.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Exile:[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted Seeds of Punishment to be a little bit more aggressive[/p][/*][*][p]Increase Hook Timer penalty from being hit by Seeds of Punishment to [b]3s[/b] (was 1s)[/p][/*][*][p]Decrease Seeds of Punishment immunity when being hit to [b]0.5s[/b] (was 2s)[/p][/*][*][p]Increase distance between Seeds of Punishment to [b]4m[/b] (was 3m)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Addons:[/p][list][*][p][b]Holy Winged Icon
